messages:
Devon (Sales): Hey @Aria, customer NimbusAI just asked for a temporary capacity bump for a scheduled embedding sweep. They need +120 GPUs in us-west for ~48h starting Mon 2025-12-01 02:00 UTC. Can we do a quota override? High priority—CXM health check requires it.
Aria (Support): Hi Devon — Can you paste the expected qps and tokens? We need justification for override per quota policy. Also, which model/instance type? :clipboard: 
Devon (Sales): It's 100k embeddings (text-embedding-3-large) run as batch with batch_size=2048. Estimate peak concurrent workers=80 -> ~120 gpus if sharded. Cost commit is signed; PO attached in ticket link: https://payments.example/po/9876
Kai (Eng-SRE): Heads up — us-west GPU pool currently at 92% 24h avg, short-term capacity constrained. If we grant full +120 we'd push into backpressure and queueing; admission control will start rejecting low-priority requests. Suggest options: 1) move batch to us-east (lower latency to SFO?), 2) split into staggered windows, 3) allow limited override with preemption flag.
Riley (Oncall): I can approve a temporary soft-override of +12 GPUs for 72h with preemption and QoS=best-effort, provided there's rollback automation. We'll need SRE-runbook snippet updated and a support ticket created. :warning:
Devon (Sales): Staggering increases total elapsed time by 36h — customer insists on 48h end-to-end. Region change unacceptable due to data locality. Is there any way to prioritize their job? They have enterprise plan.
Aria (Support): Enterprise plan helps but quotas still enforced for platform health. We can request an exception for a hard quota but that requires Eng-SRE signoff + Ops approval. Please include SLA impact, PO, and PII/data locality verbiage.
Kai (Eng-SRE): If we must, I can propose admission control rule: allow NimbusAI project tag with rate limit 1.5x baseline, but cap at +30 GPUs. That reduces queueing risk. Also add KV cache warmup to reduce tokens/time.
Devon (Sales): Customer accepts +30 GPUs with preemption. They want guaranteed 48h window. Can we get that guaranteed?
Riley (Oncall): Can't guarantee full window in us-west at current saturation. We can guarantee +30 with preemption; if capacity remains tight we'll auto-failover to best-effort or throttle. I'll add daily check-ins.
Devon (Sales): OK go ahead with +30. Please create exception ticket and update them.
Aria (Support): Creating internal exception ticket now.
quota-bot: Quota exception request created: Q-4872. Details: requester=Devon (Sales), customer=NimbusAI, region=us-west, requested=+30 GPUs, duration=48h, preemption=enabled.
Kai (Eng-SRE): Added admission-control rule draft:
```
rule: allow project=nimbusai tag override_gpus=30 preemptible=true window=2025-12-01T02:00:00Z/2025-12-03T02:00:00Z
```
Aria (Support): @Riley @Kai please add the rollback command and runbook link in the ticket. I'll notify customer once we have Eng signoff.
Riley (Oncall): Rollback command:
```
rbacctl revoke-override --id Q-4872 && notify nimbusai --status=preempted
```
Riley (Oncall): Marking this as P1 internal until 2025-12-03 03:00 UTC. I'll be on watch during window. :eyes:
Devon (Sales): Thanks team :pray: I'll update the customer and attach PO/t&c.
Aria (Support): Noted. Closing thread once exception is approved and runbook is linked.
